## Section 0001: Temporal Video Engine & Synchronization — System Synthesis & Invariants

This synthesis section details the architectural invariants, memory layouts, and data pipelines for temporal video engine & synchronization.
Modern video editing in client environments requires strict synchronization guarantees between distinct runtime threads.

### Sub-System 1.1: PTS / DTS Presentation Clock

- **Theoretical Basis**: Handling presentation time stamped frame queues with monotonic AudioContext sync.
- **Implementation Strategy**: Memory-efficient ring buffers with zero garbage collection overhead.
- **Mathematical Invariant**: Error bound epsilon < 0.001 at 60 FPS playback rates.
- **Hardware Target**: WebGPU compute fallback to WebAssembly SIMD and WebGL2 shaders.
- **Edge Conditions**: Rapid scrub velocity, out-of-order frame arrival, and temporal discontinuity.
- **Integration Matrix**: Synchronized across timeline ruler, preview monitor, and export encoder.
